display_name.ui:title: Display name
display_name.ui:description: The name people see in the agent list and in a conversation.

published_by.ui:title: Published by
published_by.ui:description: Set by the server when the draft is published.

summary.ui:title: Summary
summary.ui:description: One or two sentences on what it is for.

template_id.ui:title: Address
template_id.ui:description: Set by the server when the draft is published.

version.ui:title: Version
version.ui:description: Set by the server when the draft is published.

persona.ui:title: Instructions
persona.ui:description: What the agent is for and how it answers, in plain sentences. Nothing written here can widen what it may read.

placeholders.ui:title: Questions for whoever installs it
placeholders.ui:description: What each company must answer when it installs this agent, such as where its price list is kept.

key.ui:title: Short name
key.ui:description: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter: price_list.

prompt.ui:title: Question
prompt.ui:description: What the person installing it is asked.

tier.ui:title: Model size
tier.ui:description: How much thinking it does. Main suits most agents.

scope.ui:title: Records it may read
scope.ui:description: Conditions every record must meet. With none it narrows nothing, and it never reads more than the person using it may.

clauses.ui:title: Conditions
clauses.ui:description: Every condition must hold for a record to count.

field.ui:title: Field
field.ui:description: The record's field: lower-case letters, digits, underscores and dots, starting with a letter: department.

value.ui:title: Value
value.ui:description: One value for is and starts with, a list for is one of, and none for any value.

skills.ui:title: Skills
skills.ui:description: Reviewed procedures it follows, each pinned to the version that was reviewed.

name.ui:title: Skill name
name.ui:description: As the Skills page shows it: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter.

digest.ui:title: Fingerprint
digest.ui:description: The reviewed version's fingerprint: 64 characters, digits and the letters a to f.

allowed_tools.ui:title: Tools it may use
allowed_tools.ui:description: Each by the tool's name: helpdesk.read_ticket. Only these can be called, or drawn in a procedure.

ui:options.addLabel: Add a tool it may use

capabilities.ui:title: Permissions
capabilities.ui:description: What it may do, each written as a verb, a colon and a thing, with a field after a dot if you need one: read:invoice.total. The verbs are read, write, invoke, approve and admin.

required_tools.ui:title: Tools it cannot work without
required_tools.ui:description: Tools this install must have before it can be switched on, each by the tool's name.

ui:options.addLabel: Add a tool it cannot work without

connectors.ui:title: Connectors
connectors.ui:description: The systems it needs connected before it can be switched on, each by the connector's name: helpdesk.

leash.ui:title: Approval settings
leash.ui:description: How much a person is involved before an action. Every action starts at Shadow, and a setting is raised later from the agent's own runs.

target.ui:title: Action
target.ui:description: A kind of record, or one action on it after a dot: invoice, or ticket.update_status. Lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

scope.ui:title: Records it applies to
scope.ui:description: With no conditions it applies to every record.

clauses.ui:title: Conditions
clauses.ui:description: Every condition must hold for a record to count.

field.ui:title: Field
field.ui:description: The record's field: lower-case letters, digits, underscores and dots, starting with a letter: department.

value.ui:title: Value
value.ui:description: One value for is and starts with, a list for is one of, and none for any value.

max_side_effect.ui:title: The most it may do
max_side_effect.ui:description: The strongest effect any one of its actions may have.

ui:enumNames.draft: Drafts for a person to send

golden_set.ui:title: Test questions
golden_set.ui:description: Questions it must still answer well once installed, each with what a good answer says.

expectation.ui:title: What a good answer says
expectation.ui:description: In words rather than an exact answer: it is judged, not matched.
